description: Unauthenticated MQTT Access Without proper authentication, attackers can connect to the MQTT broker and publish malicious data or subscribe to sensitive data streams. An attacker could spoof an IoT device and inject false sensor readings, potentially causing incorrect energy management decisions or data pollution.
references: recommendation: Implement IoT Core device authentication using X.509 certificates
recommendation: Implement IoT Core policies for fine-grained access control
